title: Settings
description: The deployment-wide settings: deletion_grace, reserved_slugs, users, route_checks and defaults in plat5.yml.

deletion_grace.title: deletion_grace
deletion_grace.description: How long a deleted node stays restorable before it's purged. One value for every kind. A duration: a whole number and `s`, `m`, `h` or `d` (`30d`, `12h`). Default `30d`. A change applies to new deletes only.

reserved_slugs.title: reserved_slugs
reserved_slugs.description: Slugs no node may take, deployment-wide.

users.title: users
users.description: How Plat5 reads a person from the IdP's token.

route_checks.title: route_checks
route_checks.description: The gateway's route checks: whether the caller may call each of a batch of routes, for a UI that hides what the caller can't use ([gateway](../gateway.md#route-checks)).

defaults.title: defaults
defaults.description: What a service gets for a field it leaves out.

name.title: name
name.description: Where a person's name comes from at sign-in, and when a sign-in sets it.

claims.title: claims
claims.description: The token claims that may hold the person's name, read in order: the first non-empty one wins. 1 to 8, each a dotted path like `AUTH_SUBJECT_CLAIM` (`name`, `profile.display_name`). Default `[name, preferred_username]`.

sync.title: sync
sync.description: When a sign-in sets the name. `first_sign_in`: only while the person's name is empty. `each_sign_in`: on every sign-in with a non-empty claim, and the person can't change it themselves. Default `first_sign_in`.

claim.title: claim
claim.description: A dotted path into the token's claims: segments of anything but dots and spaces, joined by dots. At most 128 characters.

path.title: path
path.description: Where the gateway answers them, for `POST`. Literal segments of lowercase letters, digits, `-`, `_` and `.`, none starting with `.`; at most 256 characters. No route may match it, in any method (**422**, naming the route). Default `/access/routes`.

timeouts.title: timeouts
timeouts.description: `{ connect, read }`, each a duration. Default `10s` and `30s`.

max_body_bytes.title: max_body_bytes
max_body_bytes.description: The largest request body the gateway forwards, in bytes. Default `10485760` (10 MiB).

slug.title: slug
slug.description: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens; starts with a letter, doesn't end with a hyphen; 3 to 63 characters.

duration.title: duration
duration.description: A whole number and a unit: `s`, `m`, `h` or `d`.
